business_problem: Simplex wanted a repeatable way to measure and scale AI-driven software delivery across design, implementation, testing, and operations instead of relying on ad hoc developer experiments.
solution_summary: Simplex adopted ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex as the foundation of an AI-first development model that spans design, coding, testing, and remediation. After establishing a center of excellence to validate AI-native development processes, the company selected Codex as its primary coding agent so teams could accumulate know-how and compare impact across projects. Codex is used not only for code generation, but also for implementation from design documents and reference examples, unit-test generation, review and remediation of nonfunctional requirements, and fixes for issues found during internal integration testing. The team is also validating workflows in which Codex CLI runs Python scripts and iterates from server implementation through test failures. Instead of mapping AI one-to-one onto traditional stages, Simplex is redesigning software delivery around rules, repeated integration, and automated evaluation, with people retaining final accountability for quality and delivery decisions.

data_flow: Design documents, reference implementations, and test results are fed into Codex and Codex CLI, which generate code, tests, review outputs, and fixes. Teams then evaluate the results quantitatively across projects and keep people responsible for final quality, sign-off, and operating-model changes.
business_outcome: Simplex quantified substantial efficiency gains across design, development, and integration testing, created a primary AI-agent standard for the organization, and established an AI-first delivery model that can be rolled out across more projects.
